recipe.criteria: Straight-leg hanging raise with two weighted ankle cuffs; 3.5 seconds up to hip height, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds down. Fixed trunk and overhead grip without swinging. Cuffs stay secured on the lower shins.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
